name: jack
character: Jack Frost (the first character on the select screen)
facing: right: the sprite the game shows while walking right. The game is top-down, so this is a three-quarter overhead view, not a profile
colors: harness-tags colorMode 0 (Game's own), color packs enabled; pixels are the emulator's output, nothing repainted
scene: Floor 1: tutorial text cleared with A, DOWN from frame 2700, RIGHT held from frame 2770; walking right along the first corridor. Jack Frost is the default pick, no extra press
frames: 2772-2807 (one full cycle plus the start of the next; every frame of a cel is pixel-identical)

canvas.alignment: feet on the bottom row; all three cels have the same columns, so they play in place

speed_note: measured from the scrolling floor: 2,2,2,3 px on successive frames (the camera is locked to the character), so 18 px per cel
cycle_note: the cycle is cel 1, 2, 1, 3 (the first cel plays twice); entries repeat the file
game_dy_note: px lower than the highest cel the game draws this cel; the PNGs ignore it so every foot sits on the bottom row
palette_note: distinct opaque RGB colors across all cels of this character; every pixel is fully opaque or fully transparent
